- Bottom: purple 5x10

- Top: purple 5x10
- Bottom: white 5x10

Wait, let me check the history. Earlier when the top rectangle was purple, the split was purple over white. Now the top rectangle is white, but the split is still purple over white. So the split state doesn't update when I change the top rectangle's color - it only updates when I split.
So if I split now (with top rectangle = white), the top half should be white and the bottom half should be white. Let me try splitting and see.
Actually, I need to first merge (to get back to 2 blocks), then split again (to get 3 blocks with updated colors).
But SPACE isn't working to merge/split anymore! It only changes the HUD bar.
Hmm, let me try SPACE one more time to see if it works now.
